verdict_text: YES. The script casts exactly the 112 listed projection-matrix names to bfloat16 via `.to(torch.bfloat16)`, leaves all other tensors as unchanged float32 (embed_tokens and lm_head included), preserves all 114 names, and asserts the four required checks before writing. The `buffer_re` for buffer removal is effectively a no-op (the `(?!)` empty-lookahead can never match), but since the input checkpoint has no buffers and requirement 3 says nothing should be deleted, this has no observable effect and satisfies the spec for this input. The sharder packs tensors in original order under the 256 MiB (268,435,456-byte) cap and isolates any oversized tensor (embed_tokens/lm_head) into its own shard regardless of position, correctly writing a `weight_map` covering all 114 tensors, matching the required sharded layout.
